verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a first-party API reference for the AI Gateway (Konnect AI Gateway v1), with documented operations such as list-ai-gateways. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the common paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
